Selected image saved unchanged after 2 tool calls (1 generation + 1 edit). Remaining acceptance failures are reported as instructed.

Source and copy are byte-identical. Initial prompt sent verbatim.

1. PASS — Exactly 4 views, ordered FRONT, LEFT (nose right), BACK, RIGHT (nose left).
2. FAIL — Pixel bounds measured using minimum RGB channel <200: tops 169/167/169/167; bottoms all 503. Side widths 630 and 608 pixels, so lengths and mirrored outlines are not exact.
3. FAIL — Principal colours and components remain recognizable, but side engines project, hatches sit on yellow hull, and hull/module geometry differs from the accepted sheet.
4. FAIL — No text, legends, figures or extraneous marks visible. Background is not pure white: only 9.25% of the top 50 rows are exactly #FFFFFF.
5. FAIL — Clear space separates all views, with horizontal gaps of 48/58/31 pixels. Subtle colour variation and shading remain; fills are not strictly flat.

Edit prompt, verbatim:

Change only the ship geometry and rendering to match the accepted reference sheet (the second attached image): restore the large sweeping yellow deck lobes, small low head, orange upper spine, rectangular teal underslung modules, small magenta sockets, red hatch, and recessed grey rear block with four dark nozzles; remove added panel greebles, exposed machinery and projecting engines. Restore bright yellow, orange, teal, red and magenta solid flat fills with no gradients, shading or texture, and a pure white (#FFFFFF) background. Preserve the first image's four-view order and mirrored side outlines, and align every view's top and bottom exactly at the same scale.

KEEP: the four views FRONT, LEFT, BACK, RIGHT in one row at one scale on one baseline; the ship's shape, parts, colours and proportions as the reference sheet (Image 1); pure white background; no text, labels, legend, lines, figure or silhouette. Add nothing not listed above.
